    Humans¶

    The dominant species of Ge'or and one of the Six Main Races. Descended from the survivors of the Glorious Alliance crash ~15,000 BGD, humans rule the largest empires, control the busiest trade routes, and populate every continent. They are also the species the Shadows most want to control — because humans are the species that originally defeated them.

    Biology¶

    • Appearance: Varies by region — see the sub-race table below. Predominantly Caucasian across Erisdar; the eastern Asian branch in Tabontabar and the South Sun Empire descends from a single family that migrated east millennia ago
    • Lifespan: 70–80 years on average
    • Health: Near-perfect baseline — diseases and mental illness are almost eradicated on Ge'or. Healing mages make injury far less lethal than on medieval Earth
    • Mage-cell expression: Widely variable — some bloodlines produce powerful mages, others none. Dilution through interbreeding has gradually reduced pure mage-blood families
    • Genetics: The most compatible species on Ge'or — humans can interbreed with Elves, Dwarves, Beast Races, and Catmen (but NOT Demons)

    Society¶

    Human society spans the full spectrum of governance — theocratic empire (Erisian Empire), plutocratic trade republic (Anos Plutocracy, Venner), feudal duchies (Archduchy of the Kennberg), and republics (Grimmel Republic). No single culture dominates; adaptability is humanity's defining trait.

    • Culture: Commerce, politics, and empire-building. Humans are the species that builds — cities, institutions, religions, and armies
    • Relations: Dwarves genuinely like them — human markets buy dwarven goods. Elves tolerate them with polite condescension. Demons are disappointed in them, seeing immense potential settled for commerce. Catmen are happy to trade fashion tips
    • History: Rose to dominance in Age 7 (2999–1000 BGD); the age ended with the rise of Baoth in 967 BGD

    Regional Sub-Races¶

    |---|---|---| | Central Erisdar | Fair skin, brown to auburn hair, robust build — Germanic | Baothians | | South Erisdar (Grimmel peninsula, southern Empire) | Olive skin, dark hair, lean build — Mediterranean | Irikod | | North Erisdar | Tall, blond, fair-skinned, broad-shouldered — Nordic | Axels | | East Erisdar | Sturdy, fair to olive skin, gray or blue eyes — Slavic | Mago | | West Erisdar (sandy regions: Aenid Kingdom, Demon's Horn) | Darker skin, sharp features — Arabic and Mediterranean | — | | Dissenbarg | Olive skin, dark curly hair, gracile build — Greek | Makod | | Tabontabar & South Sun Empire | Dark straight hair, epicanthic folds, lighter build — Asian | Eastern branch |

    The eastern Asian branch originated from a single extended family that migrated eastward millennia ago, eventually populating the Central Kingdom, Northern Kingdom, Southern Kingdom, and the South Sun Empire. They are the only major human population on Ge'or without Caucasian features — a reminder that humanity's genetic diversity, while narrowed, was never erased.

    Hybrids¶

    Humans are the most genetically compatible species on Ge'or. Interbreeding is possible with several races:

    • Half-Elf / Half-Human — the most common hybrid. Elven-human pairings are not unusual, particularly in Central Erisdar and Merratodoni.
    • Half-Dwarf / Half-Human — rare. Dwarven reproduction cycles (90–100 years to maturity) make these unions uncommon, but not impossible.
    • Half-Beastman / Half-Human — rare. Occurs primarily in multi-ethnic regions like Germina.
    • Half-Catman / Half-Human — exists, particularly in Venner, where the aristocracy's catgirl obsession has produced documented hybrids. The Erisian church forbids human-catmen marriages, but the prohibition is widely ignored.

    Demons cannot interbreed with humans. The genetic divergence between the two species — separated since the Last Great War — is too great.

    Subraces¶

    The human subraces of Ge'or are regional variations, not separate species:

    • Axels — Nordic. North Erisdar.
    • Baothians — Germanic. Central Erisdar. Dominant in the Erisian Empire.
    • Irikod — Mediterranean. South Erisdar. The merchant republics.
    • Mago — Slavic. East Erisdar.
    • Makod — Greek. Dissenbarg.
    • Georian humans — the baseline, adapted to Ge'or's gravity.
    • Earth humans — the original stock (historical).

    The Human Condition¶

    Humans are the most successful species on Ge'or by nearly every measure. They rule the largest empires, control the busiest trade routes, and populate every continent. They are also the species that the Shadows most want to control — because humans are the species that originally defeated them.

    The Demons are disappointed in humanity, seeing a species of immense potential that settles for commerce and politics instead of mastery. The Elves tolerate humans with polite condescension. The Dwarves genuinely like them — human markets buy dwarven goods. And the Catmen are happy to trade fashion tips.

    The Human Age¶

    During Age 7 (2999–1000 BGD), humanity rose to dominate Ge'or. Human empires spanned continents, their armies consistently outmaneuvering adversaries. This was the age when most modern religions were founded, languages stabilized, and Countism became the prevalent political system. The age ended with the rise of Baoth in 967 BGD — the last war of humanity.

    Connections¶

    • One of the Six Main Races: Dwarves, Elves, Demons, Beast Races, Catmen
    • Origin: Old Earth — descended from Earth humans
    • Arrived: With the crash ~15,000 BGD
    • Subraces: Axels, Baothians, Irikod, Mago, Makod, Georian humans, Human Sub-Races
    • Hybrids: Compatible with elves, dwarves, beastmen, catmen — NOT demons
    • Health: Near-perfect baseline — diseases and mental illness almost eradicated
    • Appearance: Predominantly Caucasian; Asian branch in Tabontabar/South Sun Empire
    • Empires: Erisian Empire, trade republics, colonial networks └── Role: The dominant species — for better and worse
